name: Sojourner Transport
description: The Sojourner Transport, also known as the Jedi Sojourner, was a class of small transport that was used by the Jedi Order in the final years of the Old Republic and throughout the Order's history. They became very rare after the Great Jedi Purge and the Age of the Empire.

data.name: Sojourner Transport
data.firstuse: In the final years of the Old Republic
